text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I was no match for her at all... Ayabe-san 
is... so strong...

âHer strength went far beyond the 
winning margin. The sheer difference in 
their resolve was clearly evident in the 
race.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"You probably already knew all along... 
right, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
They said the Derby was too early for me. 
Even so... just as a memento, they said.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to say thank you. But I feel too 
pathetic to even say it...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm still clumsy, sluggish, and slow as 
ever. But... at least I've reached the 
point where I realize I can't stay this 
way forever.
choice_data_list: Even just that might be growth.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. I can't smile just yet, but... 
someday...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I want to become the kind of person who 
can smile and say even a big race like 
this was fun. Uuu...

"A single page etched with defeat. Yet, 
let us believe that it too will become an 
invaluable page in Meisho Doto's story."
